usedFor: Shopify holds shoppers and checkouts, and SerwerSMS keeps text contacts through “Add Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Add Contact” in SerwerSMS
bestTemplate.why: An abandoned checkout carries the shopper's phone, so it can be saved as a text contact.

watchOut: “Add Phone Number to Blacklist” stops a number from receiving SMS, so keep it off cancellations unless intended.
